query:
SELECT discord_user_id AS "discord_user_id?",
               discord_display_name AS "discord_display_name?"
        FROM twitch_streamer_identities
        WHERE ($1 <> '' AND twitch_user_id = $1)
           OR ($2 <> '' AND LOWER(twitch_login) = $2)
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
